title: unhandled-mail-lands-in-the-logs-tree
intention: Mail codemother cannot dispatch lands in the logs tree, where it ages out, instead of piling up in her instance space and riding into every tester seal.
why: Gap C of the 2026-10-05 re-plan relayed by akiendelllinux_cc_0 (/home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md). The lived symptom: the bare cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_isolation.py run at HEAD on 2026-10-06 measured 'scratch: 203.7MB disk, 11980 entries' against its 150MB bound, so every tester seal copies a sandbox a third over budget. 79MB of that is ~/.cairn/devices/codemother/0/mail (3,682 files), replies to her own requests that nothing reads or forgets.
traces_to: Law 5 and Law 6's berth rule (cairn/tools/base/address.py log_path: the logs tree holds what HAPPENED to a thing, forgotten past 30 days; instance space holds its life); the tester's seal bound (ticket 1c4ae8f053fe: a per-proof sandbox under 150MB, enforced by cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_isolation.py); RULE 1 (the change lives in codemother, which owns where her mail lands)
how: In cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py set _MAIL_DIR = log_path('codemother', 0) / 'mail' instead of instance_path('codemother', 0) / 'mail', dropping the unused instance_path import and _INSTANCE_ROOT. Then move (mv, never a delete) the standing files from ~/.cairn/devices/codemother/0/mail into ~/.cairn/logs/codemother/0/mail. Proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_unhandled_mail_lands_in_the_logs_tree.py, written red 0/4.
falsifier: GREEN when cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_unhandled_mail_lands_in_the_logs_tree.py prints four ok lines and exits 0: (1) _persist writes under log_path('codemother',0)/mail; (2) nothing lands under devices/codemother/0/mail; (3) CodeMotherDevice.state()['mail_dir'] names the logs address; (4) the live ~/.cairn/devices/codemother/0/mail holds no files; and `python3 cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py` exits 0, and the bare `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_isolation.py` passes with its 150MB bound unchanged. RED if any fails. Wrong intent if anything reads codemother's unhandled mail back as state she needs.

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: apply exactly the unified diff carried in this ticket's build_patch field (`git apply` from a file holding that text, run in the cairn repo root). It edits only cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py: the address import becomes `from cairn.tools.base.address import log_path, tool_path`, the _INSTANCE_ROOT line goes, and _MAIL_DIR = log_path('codemother', 0) / 'mail'. No other code changes.

D2: SETTLED: the proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_unhandled_mail_lands_in_the_logs_tree.py is already on disk, committed red (0 of 4 at HEAD). After the build and the move (D3) it prints four ok lines and exits 0. Regressions: `python3 cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py` exits 0, and the bare `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_isolation.py` passes with its 150MB bound unchanged (the bound is the tester's falsifier and is never edited by this ticket).

D3: SETTLED: after the patch, move the standing mail once, with mv and never a delete: `mkdir -p ~/.cairn/logs/codemother/0/mail && find ~/.cairn/devices/codemother/0/mail -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec mv -t ~/.cairn/logs/codemother/0/mail/ {} +` (find, because 3,682 files overflow a shell glob). The emptied directory may stay; tooth 4 counts files only. If the bare test_isolation still reads over 150MB after the move, report the measured size and stop: the remaining overage is other devices' growth and is its own ticket.
